sloka: एवमुक्त्वा तु काकुत्स्थं जनको हृष्टमानसः ।प्रययौ मिथिलां श्रीमांस्तमनुज्ञाय राघवम् ।। ७.३८.८ ॥
transliteration: evamuktvā tu kākutsthaṁ janako hṛṣṭamānasaḥ ।prayayau mithilāṁ śrīmāṁstamanujñāya rāghavam ।। 7.38.8 ॥

translations.english: Having thus spoken to Rama, the glorious Janaka, with a joyful mind, took leave of Rama and departed for Mithila.
